metadata.scenario: A customer calls to cancel their membership as they are relocating abroad. Category: Cancellation. Flags: cancellation_request.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Agnes Rodriguez. I hope you’re doing well. Hi Agnes! I'm doing well, thank you. How about you? I'm okay, but I have some news that's a bit difficult to share. Oh, I’m here to listen. What’s going on? Well, I’m relocating abroad, and I need to cancel my home healthcare services. I understand. That must be quite a change for you. Yes, it really is. I’ve been with you for two years, and I hate to leave. We’ve loved having you as a client, Agnes. Can I ask where you’re moving to? I’m going to live with my daughter in Spain. It’s a big move for me. That sounds exciting! Do you have everything arranged for your move? Mostly, but I still have some loose ends to tie up, including this cancellation. Of course, let’s take care of that. I’ll start the cancellation process for you. Thank you. I appreciate that. Is there anything specific you'd like us to note regarding your care? Just that I’m grateful for the companionship and support during my time with you. We’re so glad to hear that. Your caregiver truly enjoyed spending time with you in the garden. I’ll miss those activities. They meant a lot to me. If your new location offers similar services, let us know if you need help finding them. That would be helpful, thank you. I’ll compile a list of resources for you and send it via email. What’s the best address to use? Please send it to my email: agnes.rodriguez@email.com. Got it. I’ll follow up with that. And can we schedule a final visit for next week? Yes, we can arrange that. What day works best for you? How about Tuesday? Tuesday sounds great! I’ll confirm that with your caregiver. Thank you, Margaret. I’m glad we can at least have that final visit. Absolutely. It will be a nice way to say goodbye. Can I ask, will I still be charged for next week or after I cancel? You won’t be charged after your cancellation, but we’ll finalize everything during your visit. Great! I really appreciate all the support you’ve given me. It’s been our pleasure. You’ll always be part of the CareFirst family. Thank you, that means a lot. Is there anything else you need, Agnes? No, that’s all for now. I’ll look forward to the email and our Tuesday visit. Sounds good! Take care, Agnes. Safe travels! Thank you, Margaret. Goodbye! Goodbye!
